label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Use headings and bullet points
body: Make your emails easy to skim by breaking up text with clear headings and concise bullet points, helping readers quickly grasp your message.
caption:
When someone opens your email, they often scan it first. If it looks like a big block of text, they might get overwhelmed and click away. Using clear headings helps them see the main topics, and bullet points make lists of benefits or steps super easy to digest. It’s all about making your message as accessible as possible. Make your next email a breeze to read! ✨
